description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Siribopura, Hambantota D/S Division, Hambantota District (25/0205)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring ownership of multiple land parcels with detailed cadastral information, parcel numbers, and ownership details (including The State and Land Reform Commission). This fits the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
